reason: The README documents a media-generation plugin centered on image, video, and audio creation with a node-link canvas for organizing prompts, references, and outputs; its default backend is a local stub, with configurable external backend support described but not implemented.

summaries.zh: 一个通过节点连线画布组织文生图、文生视频、参考生视频和文本生成音频任务的媒体工具插件。
summaries.en: A media tool plugin that organizes text-to-image, text-to-video, reference-based video, and text-to-audio generation through a node-linked canvas.

capabilities: Provides tools for text-to-image, text-to-video, reference-based video, and text-to-audio generation
Persists canvas metadata and media files under the current working directory
Provides an HTTP/WebSocket canvas interface and an optional sidebar visualization
Supports a configurable AIGC backend endpoint, while the documented default is a local stub backend
